all_row.norm: all-row maximum absolute difference / max(physical equation scale*actual integrated physical volume, sum absolute primitive increments)
all_row.scope: current represented state, conservative unmasked operator; prescribed-row replacement separately checked; not analytical equilibrium cancellation or spatial/temporal convergence

continuous_weak.scope: analytical continuous fields and independently differentiated forcing on native test functions; all physical face fluxes included; projected/evolved residual is a separate object

geometry.scope: native chart rows independently transformed to physical Cartesian gradients; all cell faces, oriented cofactors and all-mode element Stokes identities

tensor.scope: CT6 canonical native CHART rows only: independent Nektar BwdTrans/PhysDeriv/Integral, signed CG packing, faces and restriction; physical transforms require the separate mapped metric/operator checks
